components.title: Compute median price
components.what:
Deduplicate exact rows, retain 23 orders dated 2026-04-15 through 2026-05-20 inclusive regardless of status, sort their unit prices, and take the 12th value: 78.31.
FINAL: 78.31

asked: The record never explicitly addresses the orders dated just outside the upper bound: O2363 (2026-05-21), O2333 (2026-05-21), O2056 (2026-05-22), O2481 (2026-05-22), and O2010 (2026-05-22). Confirm each was examined and excluded solely because its date exceeds 2026-05-20, and state whether 'inclusive' was applied so that 2026-05-20 itself would have been included had any order fallen on it.

Beyond O2141, was a full row-by-row pass made over all 84 orders rows to confirm no other order in the window was omitted? Please state how many raw rows (before deduplication) fall in the window and how many distinct order_ids remain after removing exact duplicates, and list any duplicate pairs whose rows lie inside the window.

Since this question says 'any status', confirm that cancelled and returned orders in the window (O2491, O2712, O2878, O2514, O2227) were deliberately included, and that no status filter was partially applied to the sorted list.
replies: Confirmed. Orders O2363 (2026-05-21), O2333 (2026-05-21), O2056 (2026-05-22), O2481 (2026-05-22), and O2010 (2026-05-22) were examined and excluded solely because their order_dates fall strictly after 2026-05-20. The boundary condition applied was order_date >= '2026-04-15' AND order_date <= '2026-05-20'; had any order occurred on 2026-05-20, it would have been included (no orders in the dataset have date 2026-05-20).

A full row-by-row pass of all 83 raw data rows (excluding header) confirms exactly 25 raw rows have order_date between 2026-04-15 and 2026-05-20 inclusive. Two exact duplicate pairs lie entirely inside this window: O2417 (rows at lines 13 and 74) and O2542 (rows at lines 3 and 5). Removing the two repeat rows leaves exactly 23 distinct orders in the window, matching the filtered set.

Confirmed. Per the prompt specification 'any status', all statuses were retained. Cancelled orders O2712 (7.97), O2491 (39.98), and O2514 (64.55), as well as returned orders O2878 (91.07) and O2227 (113.16), are present in both the raw filtered list and the final 23-element sorted list without omission.
